reuse.why: Adds the rule inside the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount that all six provider link handlers delegate to, reusing the account row it already loaded.

duplication.why: The upgrading-account lookup is hoisted and reused rather than repeated; the closed check exists once.

placement.why: The precondition sits at the top of the shared link routine in accounts/app.ts, next to the existing already-linked check.

scope.why: Only the shared link routine and its tests change.

maintainability.why: A single early-validation block in the one link path is straightforward to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All providers reach the check through linkBankSyncAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the previous in-branch lookup was moved, not copied.

one_place.where: linkBankSyncAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, used by every provider link handler.
